entities.summary: Marta Sanz Pastor is a Spanish writer. Her work includes the novels Susana y los viejos, Daniela Astor y la caja negra, Los mejores tiempos. and most recently Farandula which won the 2015 Premio Herralde. She is also a noted poet; among her notable works is the award-winning collection Vintage.
